geometry: A white italic I drawn as a single straight-edged path with slanted horizontal serifs and a diagonal stem. The canvas is 22 by 22 pixels; visible source alpha spans x=6–15 and y=5–16, with transparent background. The serifs are approximately 2 pixels tall. Native and 8x renders were generated, and the enlarged render was visually inspected.
limitations: The original antialiasing and its small-pixel edge coverage are approximated by smooth vector edges. Position and scale were tuned against the original; the updated 8x rendering was inspected.
